limits: This covers the selected public behavior, not a blanket cross-version guarantee for every SDK operation.
The old SDK Head schema describes private format v2; the cross-version gate does not parse current format v3 with it. It checks post-cleanup refusal through the native Code Mode path instead.
History Queue producers are registered, but no history consumer is attached; the native broker accepts/drops those messages. Queue/history delivery is not proven.
Cleanup recovery invokes the real alarm handler after making retry work due through the fixture; automatic alarm scheduling is not asserted.
Browser authentication, oRPC transport identity, full model turns, production Minutei bindings and remote CI remain unverified. No probe or application deployment was performed.
GitHub work and package publication remain deferred at user request. Default consumer dependencies stay on immutable 0.9.0 URLs.
